Fun anime, but not that good. The plot was a mess, but the entertaining kind of mess. For me the best part were the character designs of some characters and how ridiculous the situations could get. It felt similar to Yamada-kun and and the Seven Witches but not as good.

Galilei Donna 1-11/11 Episodes

I really liked the character designs of the three sisters. That and the voice acting of a certain character are what made me finish this. It was mostly fun but the plot felt really weird at times. The World God Only Knows I & The World God Only Knows II 12+12 Episodes
